newsitem.title: GERMANY: Siemens PR components div profit to fall.
newsitem.headline: Siemens PR components div profit to fall.

text.p: German electronics and engineering giant Siemens AG said on Thursday profit in its passive components and electron tubes (PR) division would likely fall 20 to 30 percent in 1996/97.
Preliminary figures released last week showed the division earned 239 million marks before taxes in the year ended September 30.
Division chief executive Klaus Ziegler said the main reason for the expected profit drop was price declines due to industry overcapacity.
The division would respond by reducing jobs in Germany and transferring production to lower-wage countries, Ziegler said.
PR is one part of the components division, which also includes semiconductors and electromechanical components.
